scope: Mechanical retention of 3 explicitly released frozen final-review packets only. Scientific verdicts and reviewer independence remain in each byte-exact packet; this retention is not a new acceptance.

baseline.qualification: Actual merged baseline is preserved in each review. Review saving and checks precede this separate mechanical retention package.

portable_paths: Archive and member paths are relative; source_owner_basename identifies provenance, not an extraction destination or required absolute path.

format.member_order: lexicographically sorted per packet; consecutive split parts
format.partition_method: Conservative payload padded to512 plus4096 bytes per member; no member split or omission.

limits: Every physical source-owner file included, including manifest/freeze, failures and hidden/ignored files.
Nested containers are retained and hashed as opaque outer file payloads; their contents are not decoded or newly scientifically reviewed.
Only explicitly released final review owners are included. Root CI, merge and publication evidence outside those owners remain excluded.
This index carries no new scientific verdict, global discovery/exhaustion claim or issue closure.

packets.scope: Independent actual record/HTML/SVG/KGX integration and issue636 history-wrapper review.
packets.limits: Excludes reviewer-authored authority/retention acceptance and scientific bibliography approval; no browser/pixel claim. Original harness failures and corrected probes remain retained.

packets.scope: Completed independent one-record scientific review and exact governed saved pair/check receipts; source verdict is pass with limitations and zero findings.
packets.limits: Finite source reading, unavailable or unread primary/SI/figure evidence and attributed scientific conflicts remain; adapter, staged XML packaging and publication are separate. This later retention archive was not an inspected canonical input.

packets.scope: Independent issue637 narrow source-XML whitespace attribute successor, staged byte integrity, Git controls and three exact reproduced snapshots.
packets.limits: Packaging successor only, not full scientific/authority reacceptance; earlier accepted authority-source packet remains unchanged. PR/merged-tree verification and issue closure are separate.
